object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests, with blind tests written from the requirements alone for what they missed.
object.description: Open a repository with the documents DOC and PARENT. From another program, create the document NEWDOC, then activate the Project Explorer. Expected: DOC, PARENT and NEWDOC are listed. Delete NEWDOC's folder and activate the Project Explorer again. Expected: only DOC and PARENT are listed.
